name: Fate of Fire: Kyvedy Guardiah
storyline:
"When a Mortal defeats the Aeon of Death, It's rewarded with the Eternal Life"

In search for immortality humanity challenged Death, but defeat shattered their dreams of glory and a curse was cast upon them:
"Seven days, Seven nights,
no more no less than one life
will be left in this world."

But when the world was lost in despair, Roy a young man living in the old forest, summoned the Kyvedy Fire, a mystical flame with the power to change fate.
Advised by Sir Argos to reach the top of Guardiah Tower where an ancient artifact with the power to move humanity in another world was hidden centuries ago, Roy hastens his way accompanied by his beloved Eria.

But the world outside the gates of Guardiah is in turmoil. War and rebellions shake the land and many heroes will have to play their part in the battle against Death and join the Kyvedy Fire to save the world.
summary:
An epic tale of Love, Hope and Struggle set in a Cursed world with only Seven days left.
Follow the journey of the Eleven protagonists, helped by the mysterious Kyvedy Fire, as they battle Death and Destiny to find a way to save their world in a fantasy JRPG with both Action and Turn Based Combat!
